title: Ethics
summary: For non-Muslim candidates (select in Settings). Main theories, professional ethics and civic values.
definitions: Study of moral principles governing right and wrong conduct.
Right action = greatest good for the greatest number (Bentham, Mill).
Duty-based ethics; some acts are right/wrong in themselves (Kant).
Private interest that could improperly influence official duty.
Consistent honesty and adherence to moral principles.
Being answerable for decisions and use of resources.
facts: Golden Rule: treat others as you wish to be treated.
Engineering codes put public safety, health and welfare first.
Gifts from those you regulate or pay are conflicts of interest/bribery.
Whistleblowing = reporting wrongdoing through proper channels.
Confidentiality never justifies hiding hazards to the public.
Equality before law: Article 25, Constitution of Pakistan.
